title: 100 Cims USA · America's classic peaks on your phone
description: Track your ascents across 150+ iconic American summits. Free app, iOS and Android.
heroTagline: America's classic peaks, logged from your phone.
whatIsParagraphs: 100 Cims USA is a curated collection of over 150 iconic American summits, spanning the Sierra Nevada, Rockies, Cascades, Appalachians and more. It's inspired by the Catalan 100 Cims tradition but rescoped for American mountaineers.
The list mixes accessible peaks you can day-hike with serious alpine objectives. Pick the ones that match your experience and work your way through at your own pace.
With Cims, sempre amunt you carry the full list on your phone, log each summit with a photo and date, and watch your progress stack up over the years.

faqs.q: How many peaks are in the challenge?
faqs.a: Over 150. The exact number evolves as we curate and add regional classics.

faqs.q: Do I need to summit all of them?
faqs.a: No. It's self-paced — the app tracks your progress whether you do five or fifty.
Yes. Add the real date you climbed and a photo if you have one. Your progress recalculates automatically.
